title: Betelgeuse, VLTI/MATISSE LM band, three nights on 14, 18 and 27 December 2020 (calibrated by Drevon et al. 2024 and distributed by the JMMC OiDB)
exposuresSource: No raw exposures: the 48 calibrated LM-band files of the nights Drevon et al. (2024, MNRAS 527, L88) list in their Table 1 after rejecting contaminated nights (14, 18 and 27 December 2020), from their OiDB collection f9418307-0127-49cf-8183-070127f9cf08, pinned in src/objects/betelgeuse/source/manifest.json and passed with --calibrated.

selection.continuumSource: CONTINUUM_RECIPE in tools/objects/source-authoring/betelgeuse/author.mts, the recipe of the shipped image. Its error floors are a conservative envelope over the beam-commuter repeats, not the repeats themselves. Measured on the February 2020 files, every averaged point has 8 or 12 repeats, and a least-squares fit of the repeat scatter to sqrt((a V2)^2 + b^2) gives a = 0.085 with no positive b, unchanged by correcting the small-sample bias; the median fractional scatter above V2 = 0.05 is 4.9 per cent and the median absolute scatter below it is 3.5e-4. The recipe states 0.12 and 5.65e-4, larger than both, so every error it writes is at least the measured scatter. Erring large claims less structure, the safe direction for a lens whose patches are already labelled unconfirmed. The same recipe is applied unchanged to this epoch.
